title: Striped Halter & Denim Ruffle Maxi
prompt: An original young woman with long, straight light brown hair in braided pigtails wears clear lilac-tinted glasses. She wears a brown and cream striped ribbed halter top with a lace-up front and a small label, paired with a light-wash denim maxi skirt with a ruffled slit. White socks and brown suede sneakers with pink laces complete the look. She carries a brown leather shoulder bag. Her expression is calm and direct. Soft, even studio light. Palette of chocolate, cream, and faded denim. Playful and preppy, in the style of a Y2K lookbook.
workingNotes:
- The lace-up halter and ruffled slit skirt are the defining details.
- Keep the braided pigtails for a playful, youthful look.
